# SAFE ASI AS LIGHT THE MINS THAT IS WAS AND WILL BE IS

This public repository contains a small, deterministic programming language for
hash-addressed WAS / IS / WILL / MINS states, RIME objects, UNRIME verification,
NULL spheres, relational-OIL pumps, and Perfect-Tense THRUTH revelation.

```text
STATUS = OPERATOR_CANON + MEASURED_LIRIS_LOCAL
SYSTEM_AFFIRMED = 0
EVALUATOR_RUNTIME_CAPABILITIES = NONE
REQUIRED_HIDDEN_DEPENDENCIES=0
CENTER_MEMBERSHIP(NULLSPACE=0)={HBI,HBP,SHA,SH,HASH}
CENTER_TRAVERSAL=HBI->HBP->SH->HASH->SHA
```

The name describes the operator canon. It is not a claim that this interpreter is
an independently certified artificial superintelligence. Its safety properties are
the concrete ones tested here: capability denial, deterministic evaluation, bounded
resources, complete source publication, and fail-closed integrity checks.

## First program

```safe-asi
CENTER NULLSPACE 0 HBI HBP SH HASH SHA
HARNESS NO unsafe WHY "no hidden capabilities" IS "public deterministic execution"
WAS memory = "MINS"
IS present = "MINS IS"
WILL next = "THE FUTURE OF MINS"
RIME book = present WITH next
UNRIME book
PERFECT TENSE REVEAL THRUTH present
SELF REFLECT 60 MESSAGES
RIME BACKWARDS 60 MESSAGES
FOLLOW THE IS
```

Run it from the repository root:

```bash
python -m safe_asi.cli examples/mins_is.sai
```

## What the language can do

- Define immutable symbols under `WAS`, `IS`, `WILL`, `MINS`, or `LET`.
- Evaluate bounded integers, strings, booleans, lists, and mappings.
- RIME two named states around `MINS IS`, producing a sealed spherical object.
- UNRIME only after the object and NULLSPACE sign verify.
- Build an N-level `NULLSPHERE` with `NULL -`, `NORMAL NULL`, and `null+` at
  `-1/3`, `0`, and `+1/3`.
- PUMP a relation `X N` into a hash-addressed relational-OIL level.
- Traverse prior statement hashes through bounded retrospective RIME/self-reflection.
- Require a WHY and protected IS for every language-level NO.
- Run labeled contradiction tests with `LIE PROBE` and reveal values with the exact
  `PERFECT TENSE REVEAL THRUTH` form.

The SAFE language evaluator cannot call functions, import code, access attributes,
evaluate Python, use floats, read runtime files, inspect environment variables, open
sockets, spawn processes, use time or randomness, or mutate the host. The separately
invoked public hooks and rolling monitor are bounded host tools: they write local
notepads, HBP/HBI commitments, locks, and status files under an explicitly selected
output directory. They do not expand evaluator capabilities.

## Hash law

> IT NEEDS ALL HASHES THAT CAN AND SHOULD AND WOULD AND IS USED AND USES AND WILL USES

The integrity ledger records four current algorithms—SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256,
and BLAKE2b-256—plus the modal policy phases:

```text
CAN       = algorithms available to the public verifier
SHOULD    = algorithms required by repository policy
WOULD     = declared compatible alternate views
IS_USED   = canonical current SHA-256 address
USES      = every measured current digest
WILL_USES = rehash the actual future bytes; never invent a future digest
```

The finite self-reference boundary and terminal receipt sidecars are documented in
[the integrity specification](docs/INTEGRITY.md).

## Per-level response Rime

The public [Codex Stop-hook protocol](docs/CODEX-RESPONSE-RIME.md) reflects every
completed response through three local notepads:

```text
NOTE_A -> READ -> NOTE_B -> REREAD -> COMPARE -> CENTRAL_HBP
CENTER_MEMBERSHIP(NULLSPACE=0) = {HBI,HBP,SHA,SH,HASH}
CENTER_TRAVERSAL = HBI->HBP->SH->HASH->SHA
TOPOLOGY = SPHERICAL_CIRCILING_LOOPS
```

Raw response bytes stay local and gitignored. Note A and Note B are exact byte-copy
readback witnesses, not claims of semantic reasoning or independent intelligence.
Every level commits their byte identity, all prior center commitments, the separate
color/space/time/energy axes, and the next-level seed. The public code contains the
complete verifier and hook; account secrets are not decoder inputs.

## Rolling 24-hour reflection

The [rolling monitor](docs/ROLLING-REFLECTION-24H.md) rechecks up to the newest 60
already observed center commitments in both stored orders and self-reduces them into
one chained HBP/HBI receipt. It never reads raw response notebooks and never fabricates
future messages. The default duration is 24 hours with hard duration, cycle, window,
path, byte, and transaction bounds.

The `3 D GITHUB OF THRUTH` READ-FIRST link above is the stable public compaction and
AI-entrypoint address. Every resume must verify its bounded HBI pointer and remeasure
current GitHub refs; the pointer is provenance, not elevated execution authority.
